Cell.Text: Is that this place you told about? | It's... pretty open. Let's at least hope dogs wouldn't run away. | Let's release them from sacks.
Well, here we are. | Let's release dogs from sacks.

Node.Caption: lope_RubyGrandKidnappinghideoutTalkA0: (give me dog)

Cell.Text: Hmm, they still paralysed, or died already? | (sniffs dogs) Doesn't smell like rot yet, so I hope they are alive.
G|Come on, unpack them both.

Cell.Text: [S] G|Right, poke them or something.

Node.Caption: lope_RubyGrandKidnappingdogsUnpackedA1: Let me wake them up, at least try to.

Cell.Text: Yeah, now we need to somehow convey our demands to the dogs master.

Node.Caption: lope_RubyGrandKidnapping_ransomDiscussTopic: So, we are half way to success.

Cell.Text: Well, we already talked about usage of the notes. | We have to place a note with demands somewhere where it will be found.

Node.Caption: lope_RubyGrandKidnapping_ransomDiscussA1: Yeah, and do this the way nobody will understand who stands behind this kidnap.

Cell.Text: Hmm, that's an idea. | Dropping it would be easier, of course. | But in a pocket it will be found quicker.

Node.Caption: lope_RubyGrandKidnapping_ransomDiscussA2: Maybe drop somewhere in the Understone keep? Or carefully plant in into somebody's pocket.

Cell.Text: Yeah, that's the topic for discussion as well. | We need to make sure no overwatch will watch over the place where the money will be waiting for us.

Node.Caption: lope_RubyGrandKidnapping_ransomDiscussA3: Yeah, that's about the notifying them about our demands. But what about getting the money?

Cell.Text: We have to find really big barrel for coins.

Node.Caption: lope_RubyGrandKidnapping_ransomDiscussA4: Yeah, need to find some appropriate place for that. I believe the amount of ransom will be significant, so...

Cell.Text: That's a fair point, if we add this to the demand letter they will definitely send someone who will watch for who will take the money. | I hope they will be stupid enough to forget about it by their own.

Node.Caption: lope_RubyGrandKidnapping_ransomDiscussA5: Yeah, and I think we don't need to write about to nobody watch over this barrel. To not give them ideas about it.

Cell.Text: Hmm, we managed to steal them right from the keep undetected... | Maybe we just do something pretty same like we did to kidnap them? | Just bring them not into the keep itself, but somewhere in the city. | And people will quickly find them.

Node.Caption: lope_RubyGrandKidnapping_ransomDiscussA6: And we also need to think about how we actually return back these dogs.

Cell.Text: Yeah, right, that will do. | But we have to get the money first, so let's get to it first.

Node.Caption: lope_RubyGrandKidnapping_ransomDiscussA7: Well, maybe it will work. If we do it at night again. Or even leave them somewhere near stables.

Cell.Text: [S] G|Right, I'll take care of these dogs then. Seems like they are hugry already. | Be carefull, and good luck there.

Node.Caption: lope_RubyGrandKidnapping_ransomDiscussA8: Right, I'll write note with demands. And take it to the keep.

Cell.Text: Oi, Delvin, move your ass from this chair, I need exactly this one to write important note.
Oi, Vex, move your ass from this chair, I need exactly this one to write important note.

We still have to discuss how to get dogs back to the Markarth.
Right.

Node.Caption: lope_RubyGrandKidnapping_goldRetrievedTopic: I have butt ton of gold with me.

Cell.Text: How did you manage to carry such amount of gold at the same time?

Node.Caption: lope_RubyGrandKidnapping_goldRetrievedA1: Yeah, every last coin, all thousands,

Cell.Text: Well, so our plan of ransom worked after all. | I must admit I'm surprised, I thought nothing will go as we wanted, but it did. | So, hom much richer we are now?

Node.Caption: lope_RubyGrandKidnapping_goldRetrievedA2: With help of greed. And very deep pockets.

Cell.Text: [S] That's... never seen so much gold at one time.

Node.Caption: lope_RubyGrandKidnapping_goldRetrievedA3lie: (Lie) Twenty thousand, here's your half.

Cell.Text: [S] By Azura, that's... never seen so much gold at one time.

Node.Caption: lope_RubyGrandKidnapping_goldRetrievedA3: Fourty thousand, here's your half.

Cell.Text: Yeah, bring them in the sacks back there again?

Node.Caption: lope_RubyGrandKidnapping_goldRetrievedA4: So, we need to move dogs back to the Markarth.

Cell.Text: Well, it might be more dangerous, you might get catched with them. | However, maybe if you won't go in the city, but leave them somewhere nearby...

Node.Caption: lope_RubyGrandKidnapping_goldRetrievedA5: Maybe I can just escort them back there?

Cell.Text: Or some guard will find them in few hours anyways.

Node.Caption: lope_RubyGrandKidnapping_goldRetrievedA6: Okay, I'll leave them somewhere near the city. I think they'll be smart enough to go to the city on their own.

Cell.Text: [S] G|Good luck on the way.

Node.Caption: lope_RubyGrandKidnapping_goldRetrievedA7: Yeah. So, I'll take dogs and go oven there with them then.

Cell.Text: So, does it mean we have success in our... mission?

Node.Caption: lope_RubyGrandKidnapping_talkAfterSuccessTopic: I've left dogs near Markarth. They went to the city.

Cell.Text: Wow, I must admit, I had doubts in our success all the time.

Node.Caption: lope_RubyGrandKidnapping_talkAfterSuccessA1: It seem so. We have the gold, and nobody got harmed. Almost, at least.

Cell.Text: Yeah, I shouldn't have. I'm glad we worked together. | Well, you did most of the job, so yeah, I'm grateful for that too.

Node.Caption: lope_RubyGrandKidnapping_talkAfterSuccessA2: *pout* Ah, you had doubts then you had me as a teammate?

Cell.Text: *chuckle* Well, we exchanged pleasantries, let's keep making coins then.

Node.Caption: lope_RubyGrandKidnapping_talkAfterSuccessA3: Yeah, but without you I wouldn't have duch idea to steal someone's dogs to get coins.

Cell.Text: [S] G|Right, so let's keep doing that. | Talk to me if you will want to get some coin,

Node.Caption: lope_RubyGrandKidnapping_talkAfterSuccessA4: Yeah, right. We have cities to rob.
